lifecycle.title: HTTP restarts and host-lifetime busy evidence
lifecycle.closedHandleOnce: HTTP stop closes the owned handle once
lifecycle.socketClosed: HTTP socket is shut down and closed
lifecycle.hostRecordRetained: own launch evidence survives HTTP stop
lifecycle.bootChanged: HTTP restart has a new boot ID
lifecycle.oldLaunchKeyUnknown: old launch key is unknown after restart
lifecycle.oldOperationUnknown: old operation outcome is unknown after restart
lifecycle.retryScopeFresh: retry key has a fresh scope in the new boot
lifecycle.nonGameBusy: live non-game tool holds busy with enabled HWND
lifecycle.restartMutationRefused: setup mutation is refused after HTTP restart
lifecycle.modUnchanged: refused mutation leaves the mod enabled
lifecycle.ownRetiresAfterExit: own launch evidence retires after process exit
lifecycle.noHandleDoubleClose: later stop does not close old handles twice
lifecycle.beforeFirstStartBusy: launch before first HTTP start is visible
lifecycle.stoppedCallbackNoRunner: stopped callbacks do not need a runner
lifecycle.stoppedForeignRecorded: launch during HTTP stop is recorded
lifecycle.stoppedLaunchRefuses: launch while stopped refuses later mutations
lifecycle.foreignSurvivesNoProcess: foreign record survives missing process evidence
lifecycle.stoppedFinishClears: finish during HTTP stop clears its record
lifecycle.failedStart: failed HTTP start returns an error
lifecycle.failedStartReleased: failed HTTP start releases services and runner
lifecycle.constantSubscriptions: restarts and failures keep one native subscription
lifecycle.stableCallbackOwner: native callbacks belong to the stable plugin
lifecycle.recordAfterFailures: failed starts retain one launch count
lifecycle.oneFinishClears: one finish notification clears one launch
lifecycle.lateQuitCallbacksIgnored: late shutdown callbacks do not recreate evidence
lifecycle.failedHookNotDuplicated: partially failed subscription is not duplicated
lifecycle.failedHookRecordsOnce: partially failed hook records each launch once
